content.ascii:
Commands and presentation
  CanvasViewControls.tsx
    parentViewId -> collapsible view tree
      hide archived views; show dirty state and Ctrl+S
    GenerateAlternatives -> generated candidates
  canvasViewReceiver.ts
    mutations require requestId + expectedVersion
      retain a receipt before persistence
      retry identical arguments after PERSISTENCE_PENDING
  canvasView.ts / canvasHistory.ts
    validate checkpoint existence and acyclic ancestry
    generationRunning blocks candidate edits
  CanvasViewDiffPreview.tsx
    canvasViewComparison reads start and final checkpoints
      canvasViewDiff -> DiagramDiffCanvas
